products.name: Enterprise Hard Disk Drives (HDDs)
products.description: High-capacity, reliable HDDs designed and manufactured for use in cloud data centers, enterprise storage systems, and smart video system markets. These drives are produced using advanced magnetic recording technologies and are delivered to large-scale infrastructure customers for mass data storage needs.

products.name: Client Hard Disk Drives (HDDs)
products.description: HDDs manufactured for OEM and channel customers for use in desktop and notebook computers, designed for high performance, reliability, and capacity with features such as low cost per gigabyte and low power consumption.

products.name: Consumer External Hard Disk Drives (HDDs)
products.description: External HDD storage products sold under the Western Digital and WD brands, designed for consumers to manage and store personal content, distributed globally through retail and channel partners.

products.name: Data Storage Platforms and Solutions
products.description: Integrated storage platforms and solutions, including higher value data storage systems, provided primarily to cloud and enterprise customers to enable scalable, efficient, and cost-effective data center operations. These platforms combine HDDs with additional hardware and software for enhanced storage capabilities.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a broad range of commercial loans, including commercial real estate (owner and non-owner occupied), commercial and industrial loans, and construction and land development loans. These are originated and serviced through in-person banking operations and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans such as residential mortgage loans, home equity lines, direct installment loans, overdrafts, and educational loans. These are delivered through branch networks and digital channels, requiring underwriting and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Equipment Financing and Leasing
products.description: Provides loans and leases for heavy equipment, semi-trucks, and trailers to small and medium sized businesses, primarily through its subsidiary Fountain Equipment Finance, LLC. This involves specialized underwriting and asset-backed lending.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a full range of deposit accounts and services to retail and commercial customers, including checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and insured cash sweep products. Delivered through physical branches and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales and Brokerage Services
products.description: Through a partnership with Raymond James Financial Services, offers non-FDIC insured investment products, brokerage, and investment advisory services to customers. Delivered via dual-licensed associates and digital channels, with compliance oversight.

products.name: Groceries and Fresh Foods
products.description: A curated assortment of manufacturer-branded and private label groceries, fresh foods, meat, produce, dairy, bakery, deli, and frozen products, delivered through large-format warehouse clubs and digital channels. Products are sourced directly from manufacturers and distributed via company-operated centers or direct to clubs.

products.name: General Merchandise
products.description: A selection of electronics, apparel, seasonal goods, small appliances, televisions, furniture, and other non-food items, sold in clubs and online, sourced from manufacturers and displayed in bulk for efficiency.

products.name: Gasoline Sales
products.description: Self-service gasoline sold at company-operated stations located at or near warehouse clubs, with prices generally maintained below local market averages to drive member value.

products.name: Membership Program
products.description: Annual paid memberships (Club and Club+) granting access to club shopping, digital services, gasoline, and exclusive savings, managed through physical and digital channels. Memberships are sold to individuals and businesses.

products.name: Private Label Products (Wellsley Farms and Berkley Jensen)
products.description: Premium quality private label food and general merchandise products, developed in partnership with manufacturers and sold exclusively under the Wellsley Farms and Berkley Jensen brands in clubs and online.

products.name: Specialty Services
products.description: A range of ancillary services provided in clubs, often via licensed third-party operators, including optical centers, tire installation, propane tank filling, home improvement, travel, cell phone kiosks, and product protection plans.

products.name: Digital Retail and Fulfillment Services
products.description: Online and mobile shopping platforms (BJs.com and BJ’s app) offering product browsing, digital coupons, buy-online-pickup-in-club (BOPIC), curbside delivery, same-day delivery, and ship-to-home services, supported by digital infrastructure and partnerships with third-party marketplaces.

products.name: Retail Media and Advertising Services
products.description: Advertising solutions for brands to reach BJ’s members through the BJ’s Media Edge™ retail media program, leveraging digital and in-club channels.

products.name: Olvi-Vec Oncolytic Viral Immunotherapy
products.description: A proprietary, genetically engineered vaccinia virus-based oncolytic immunotherapy developed and manufactured under cGMP conditions for the treatment of multiple aggressive and difficult-to-treat cancers. Delivered as an 'off-the-shelf' product via regional or systemic administration, it is intended to selectively kill tumor cells and induce a patient-specific immune response.

products.name: Pipeline of Oncolytic VACV Immunotherapeutic Product Candidates
products.description: A portfolio of over 500 isolated and engineered oncolytic vaccinia virus immunotherapeutic candidates, each with various transgenes and engineered attributes, intended for future development as cancer therapies. These are developed using the proprietary CHOICE discovery platform and manufactured for clinical and potential commercial use.

products.name: Licensing of Oncolytic Virus Products and Technology
products.description: Out-licensing of proprietary oncolytic viruses, including Olvi-Vec and other VACV-based candidates, to third parties for research, development, and commercialization in specific territories. This includes providing product supply and technology transfer as part of licensing agreements.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing and Supply of Oncolytic Viral Products
products.description: Manufacture and supply of cGMP-grade Olvi-Vec and related oncolytic viral products for clinical trials and potential commercial launch, including supplying licensed partners with clinical trial material under contract manufacturing agreements.

products.name: Industrial Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of owned industrial real estate properties, primarily located in Southern California infill markets, to a diversified tenant base. Properties are acquired, improved, repositioned, developed, and managed in-house, requiring physical asset management, construction, and ongoing property management services.

products.name: Industrial Property Development and Repositioning
products.description: Development of new industrial-use buildings and repositioning of existing properties through renovation, modernization, and functional enhancements. This includes converting properties to multi-tenant use, adding square footage, and upgrading building systems, delivered through in-house construction and development teams.

products.name: Mortgage Debt Investments Secured by Industrial Property
products.description: Provision or acquisition of mortgage debt investments secured by industrial properties, involving financial capital and underwriting expertise. These investments are made selectively as part of the company's capital allocation and investment strategy.

products.name: Industrial Property Dispositions
products.description: Programmatic sale of owned industrial real estate assets, including underperforming or fully-valued properties, as part of a capital recycling and portfolio optimization strategy. This involves real estate transaction management and market analysis.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate properties, primarily in Northern California, with underwriting focused on cash flow and collateral. These loans are physically originated and serviced by in-person banking staff and require regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Land and Construction Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to builders and developers for construction of residential and commercial properties, as well as loans for land acquisition. Loans are disbursed as construction progresses and require in-person underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Real Estate and Construction Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to individuals for purchasing or constructing residential properties, underwritten based on income, credit history, and collateral, and subject to statutory requirements. Delivered through physical and digital banking channels.

products.name: Farmland and Agricultural Lending
products.description: Loans to agricultural producers and processors, including lines of credit and term loans secured by farmland, with repayment primarily from agricultural production. Requires specialized underwriting and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Commercial Lending (Non-Real Estate)
products.description: Provision of loans and lines of credit to businesses for working capital, equipment, and other business needs, secured by business assets or sometimes unsecured. Delivered through relationship-based, in-person banking and digital channels.

products.name: SBA Lending
products.description: Origination and sale of Small Business Administration (SBA) 7(a) loans to small businesses nationwide, including participation in the SBA Preferred Lender Program. Loans are originated, sometimes sold in the secondary market, and require specialized regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision and purchase of unsecured, fixed-rate loans to individuals for personal or household purposes, including home repairs and improvements. Delivered through partnerships and direct origination, with underwriting based on borrower credit and income.

products.name: Deposit Products and Services
products.description: Offering of checking accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit to businesses, professionals, individuals, and municipalities. Includes related services such as debit cards, remote deposit capture, online and mobile banking, and direct deposit. Delivered via physical branches and digital platforms.

products.name: Jelmyto (mitomycin) for pyelocalyceal solution
products.description: A sustained-release hydrogel-based formulation of mitomycin, delivered via proprietary RTGel technology, for non-surgical chemoablation of low-grade upper tract urothelial cancer (UTUC). Manufactured by combining mitomycin with RTGel and administered by urologists using standard urinary procedures.

products.name: Zusduri (mitomycin) for intravesical solution
products.description: A sustained-release RTGel-based mitomycin formulation for non-surgical chemoablation of recurrent low-grade intermediate risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC). Delivered directly into the bladder via catheter as an outpatient procedure, manufactured by combining mitomycin with RTGel.

products.name: Next-generation RTGel-based mitomycin formulations (UGN-103 and UGN-104)
products.description: Investigational sustained-release RTGel-based mitomycin products, developed in partnership with medac, intended as next-generation versions of Zusduri and Jelmyto for the treatment of recurrent low-grade intermediate risk NMIBC (UGN-103) and low-grade UTUC (UGN-104). Manufactured by combining medac’s proprietary mitomycin with RTGel.

products.name: UGN-501 (oncolytic virus for urothelial cancers)
products.description: A next-generation investigational oncolytic virus therapy, engineered to selectively target and destroy cancer cells and activate anti-tumor immune response, with potential delivery via RTGel. Initially focused on high-grade non-muscle invasive bladder cancer, with plans to expand to other malignancies. Manufactured using viral engineering and bioprocessing.

products.name: Stablecoin Infrastructure Token Investment and Treasury Management
products.description: Acquisition, holding, and management of digital tokens that provide infrastructure for the stablecoin ecosystem, including tokens associated with blockchain networks, decentralized exchanges, lending protocols, oracles, and compliance tools. This is a capital allocation and digital asset management activity, with tokens held passively in treasury and not actively staked or operated.

products.name: Legacy Compact Electric Vehicles
products.description: Design and manufacturing of compact, sustainable electric vehicles, involving physical manufacturing and compliance with automotive regulations. This business line is legacy and not currently active, but may resume if production restarts.

products.name: Active Electrical Cables (AECs)
products.description: Plug-and-play copper interconnect cables designed for high-speed, lossless operation at 100G to 1.6T data speeds, manufactured using proprietary SerDes and DSP technologies and delivered as physical cable assemblies for data center and AI applications.

products.name: Optical Digital Signal Processors (DSPs)
products.description: Semiconductor chips integrated into optical transceivers and active optical cables, enabling high-speed Ethernet connectivity (50Gb/s to 800Gb/s+) over fiber for AI clusters, data centers, and telecom networks, manufactured using advanced mixed-signal and DSP architectures.

products.name: Line Card PHYs (Retimers, Gearboxes, MACsec Devices)
products.description: Integrated circuits enabling high-speed, low-power backplane and line card connectivity (up to 112G per lane) in data center switches and routers, manufactured using proprietary SerDes IP and delivered as physical IC components.

products.name: SerDes Chiplets
products.description: Multi-lane Serializer/Deserializer (SerDes) semiconductor dies provided in chiplet form for integration into multi-chip modules (MCMs) and system-on-chips (SoCs), enabling high-speed data transmission with low power and cost, manufactured using mature process nodes.

products.name: SerDes Intellectual Property (IP) Licensing
products.description: Licensing of proprietary SerDes IP cores for integration into customers' SoCs, supporting data rates from 1G to 112G per lane, delivered as digital design files and supported by engineering services.

products.name: PCIe Retimers
products.description: Integrated circuits based on proprietary SerDes and DSP technology, designed to extend PCIe trace lengths and maintain signal integrity between devices such as GPUs and SSDs in cloud-scale datacenters, manufactured using advanced process nodes and delivered as physical ICs.

products.name: PILOT Software Platform
products.description: Proprietary software platform for predictive integrity, link optimization, and telemetry, enabling network administrators to detect and resolve signal degradation in high-speed connectivity environments, delivered as a digital software solution integrated with Credo hardware.

products.name: Radio Advertising Services
products.description: Sale of advertising time on AM and FM radio stations to local, regional, national, and network advertisers. Delivered via owned and operated radio stations in multiple U.S. markets, requiring regulated broadcast infrastructure and in-person sales teams.

products.name: Digital Advertising Solutions
products.description: Integrated digital advertising services, including digital product suites that enhance audience interaction and participation, delivered through station-related websites, apps, and digital platforms. Requires digital infrastructure and data management.

products.name: Event Marketing and Sponsorships
products.description: Creation and execution of events and experiences in local communities, offering advertisers sponsorship and promotional opportunities. Delivered through in-person events leveraging station brands and local presence.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to small and medium-sized businesses, including commercial real estate loans, construction loans, working capital loans, equipment financing, lines of credit, government contract financing, asset-based lending, and accounts receivable financing. These are delivered through in-person relationship banking and digital channels, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Mortgage and Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers residential mortgage loans, home equity lines of credit (HELOCs), and other consumer loans, both originated and purchased, primarily in the local market. Delivery involves direct origination, partnerships, and portfolio purchases, requiring regulatory compliance and underwriting.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Provides a wide array of deposit accounts for individuals and businesses, including checking, savings, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit. These are delivered through branch, online, and mobile banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and digital systems.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Delivers a suite of treasury management products to business customers, including online account management, payment initiation, ACH, wires, remote deposit capture, cash management, and escrow services. These are provided via digital platforms and require secure, regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Digital and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Offers digital and mobile banking services to both business and consumer customers, enabling online account access, payments, deposits, and account management. Delivered through proprietary and third-party digital platforms, requiring ongoing technology investment and cybersecurity.

products.name: Merchant Services and Credit Card Processing
products.description: Provides merchant services and secure credit card processing for business customers, including tailored reporting and payment solutions. Delivered through partnerships with third-party providers and integrated with treasury management offerings.

products.name: Business Insurance Products
products.description: Offers a full range of business insurance products to customers through third-party networks. These are delivered via partnerships and referrals, not directly underwritten by the bank.

products.name: Cannabis Banking Services
products.description: Provides specialized banking services to licensed cannabis industry customers, including deposit accounts and compliance-focused account management. Delivery requires enhanced due diligence, compliance, and ongoing monitoring per regulatory requirements.

products.name: Cell Therapy Platforms for Cancer and Immune Diseases
products.description: Development and commercialization of innovative cell therapy platforms, including autologous and allogeneic gene-edited natural killer (NK) cell-based therapeutics, for the treatment of cancer, autoimmune, and infectious diseases. These therapies are produced using advanced cell engineering and manufacturing processes and are delivered through clinical administration to patients.

products.name: SNAP-CAR Universal Cell Therapy Platform
products.description: A universal chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) cell therapy platform that uses genetically engineered T-cells or NK cells co-administered with antibody adaptors to target a range of cancer types, including solid tumors. The platform is developed through genetic engineering and preclinical research, with the aim of providing programmable and adaptable cancer immunotherapies.

products.name: In Vitro Diagnostic Tools for Cancer Therapy Selection
products.description: Development of diagnostic tools, such as the CD38-Diagnostic, to analyze and identify cancer patients most likely to benefit from targeted monoclonal antibody therapies. These are laboratory-developed, in vitro screening devices intended to guide personalized treatment decisions.

products.name: AI-Powered Digital Marketing and Automation Services
products.description: Provision of managed digital marketing services using proprietary AI-powered marketing software and robotic process automation tools. These services include lead generation, content marketing, social media marketing, email marketing, account-based marketing, marketing analytics, event marketing, and branding support, delivered through a technology-enabled platform to external business clients.

products.name: CRISPR-based In Vivo Gene Editing Therapeutics
products.description: One-time, systemically administered gene editing therapies using proprietary CRISPR and lipid nanoparticle (LNP) technologies, designed to durably treat or potentially cure severe diseases by editing genes directly in patients' bodies. These are manufactured as biologic drugs and delivered via intravenous infusion in outpatient settings.

products.name: Ex Vivo Gene Edited Cell Therapies
products.description: Therapeutic products involving the genetic modification of human cells outside the body using CRISPR/Cas9 technology, including allogeneic (off-the-shelf) universal CAR-T cell therapies for oncology and autoimmune diseases, developed through collaborations and licensed to partners for clinical and commercial use.

products.name: Collaborative Development and Licensing of CRISPR Technologies
products.description: Out-licensing and co-development of proprietary CRISPR/Cas-based genome editing technologies and improvements (including DNA writing, base editing, and delivery platforms) to pharmaceutical and biotechnology partners for use in developing therapeutic products, generating revenue through upfront payments, milestones, royalties, and cost-sharing.

products.name: Residential Solar Energy Systems
products.description: Design, installation, and maintenance of photovoltaic solar energy systems for residential homeowners, primarily involving rooftop solar panels and related equipment. Delivered through in-person labor, regulated installation, and physical manufacturing components.

products.name: Battery Storage Systems
products.description: Provision and installation of lithium-ion battery storage systems paired with solar installations to store excess electricity, optimize energy use, and provide backup power. Delivered through physical installation and integration with solar systems.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Solar Energy Systems
products.description: Development, installation, and maintenance of photovoltaic solar arrays and renewable energy solutions for commercial, industrial, and institutional facilities, including rooftop, ground-mounted, and carport systems. Delivered through complex, regulated construction and project management.

products.name: Community Solar Services
products.description: Development and management of community solar projects that allow groups of individuals, businesses, or organizations to share the benefits of a single solar array, making renewable energy accessible to more people. Delivered through project development, regulatory compliance, and customer enrollment.

products.name: Energy Management and Grid Services
products.description: Provision of energy management control devices and grid services, including aggregation of battery storage into virtual power plants and selling grid services to utilities, primarily in the Hawaiian market. Delivered through proprietary technology and partnerships with utilities and regulators.

products.name: Service, Repair, and Maintenance of Solar and Battery Systems
products.description: Service, repair, and preventative maintenance of solar energy systems, batteries, and related components, including systems installed by competitors ('orphaned systems'). Delivered through in-person technical labor and ongoing customer support.

products.name: Residential Roofing Services
products.description: Provision of residential roofing solutions, often integrated with solar and storage installations, including new roofs and repairs. Delivered through skilled labor and partnerships with roofing manufacturers.

products.name: Cell Engineering Solutions
products.description: End-to-end biological R&D services enabling customers to discover, optimize, and manufacture biotechnology products (e.g., therapeutics, vaccines, agricultural biologics, industrial enzymes) using Ginkgo's automated lab, proprietary data, and scientific expertise. Delivered as custom programs with deliverables such as engineered strains, enzyme sequences, or bioprocesses.

products.name: Cell Engineering Tools
products.description: Provision of laboratory automation hardware (RAC systems), software, and data generation services (Datapoints) that enable customers to conduct in-house biological R&D, including AI-driven experimentation and high-throughput data collection for drug discovery and other applications.

products.name: Licensing of Biological Assets and Intellectual Property
products.description: Licensing of proprietary host cells, metagenomic libraries, and other IP assets (e.g., engineered strains, genetic parts) to customers for use in their own R&D and product development, leveraging Ginkgo's accumulated biological data and assets.

products.name: Biosecurity Services – Canopy
products.description: End-to-end biomonitoring programs for governments and institutions, including environmental sample collection at strategic nodes (e.g., airports), genomic sequencing, data analysis, and delivery of actionable insights to detect and identify biological threats.

products.name: Biosecurity Services – Horizon
products.description: A digital surveillance, analytics, and insights platform that aggregates and analyzes global biothreat data (including from Canopy and other sources) to detect, monitor, and provide intelligence on emerging biological threats for governments and organizations.

products.name: E-commerce Marketplaces for Surplus Assets
products.description: Online platforms that facilitate the sale and purchase of surplus assets—including consumer goods, capital assets, heavy equipment, industrial equipment, vehicles, electronics, and real estate—using auction and fixed-price mechanisms. These marketplaces are powered by proprietary technology and serve both business and government sellers and buyers globally.

products.name: Returns Management and Reverse Supply Chain Services
products.description: Comprehensive services for managing, processing, and reselling excess, returned, and overstocked consumer goods for retailers and manufacturers, including logistics, refurbishment, data wiping, and compliance with disposition requirements. Delivered through both full-service and self-directed models, leveraging a network of warehouses and integrated logistics.

products.name: Auction and Asset Management Software Solutions (SaaS)
products.description: Private-label and SaaS auction platform services for entrepreneurs and businesses, including marketplace creation, website hosting, email marketing, inventory management, and asset management tools. Delivered digitally via cloud-based platforms such as Auction.io and Machinio System.

products.name: Direct-to-Consumer Surplus Goods Sales
products.description: Sales of surplus and overstocked consumer goods directly to end-users through specialized online and physical retail channels, including hyper-localized pick-up and deep discount experiences. Delivered via platforms such as AllSurplus Deals, Secondipity, and Retail Rush.

products.name: Value-Added Logistics and Fulfillment Services
products.description: Integrated logistics services supporting the receipt, handling, transportation, cataloguing, inspection, grading, refurbishment, and outbound fulfillment of surplus merchandise for sellers and buyers. Includes both domestic and international shipping, inventory management, and warehouse operations.

products.name: Real Estate Auction Services
products.description: Online auction and sales services for surplus real estate assets, primarily for government and commercial sellers, delivered through dedicated marketplaces such as GovDeals and Bid4Assets.

products.name: Equipment Listing and Search Engine Services
products.description: Global online search engine and listing services for used equipment in sectors such as construction, machine tools, processing, transportation, printing, agriculture, and laboratory/medical, delivered via the Machinio marketplace.

products.name: Managed Internet Services for Multifamily and Student Housing
products.description: Design, installation, operation, and maintenance of fiber optic and WiFi networks in multifamily and student housing properties, delivered through long-term contracts with property owners. Includes network engineering, equipment installation, 24/7 network monitoring, maintenance, resident onboarding, and customer support. Requires physical network construction, technical expertise, and ongoing managed service delivery.

products.name: Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) for Multifamily and Student Housing
products.description: Turnkey internet connectivity solution where Elauwit funds, owns, and maintains the installed fiber and WiFi network in multifamily and student housing properties. Delivered under long-term service agreements, includes network design, installation, 24/7 monitoring, maintenance, resident onboarding, and customer support. Involves capital investment, physical infrastructure deployment, and ongoing managed services.

products.name: Bitcoin Mining
products.description: Operation of specialized mining machines in third-party hosting facilities to mine bitcoin, primarily through participation in mining pools. This requires significant physical infrastructure, energy consumption, and technical management.

products.name: Mining Machines Resale
products.description: Procurement of bitcoin mining machines from manufacturers and resale to external customers, typically when market shortages allow for profitable sales. This involves sourcing, inventory management, and sales agreements.

products.name: Mining Machines Rental
products.description: Short-term rental of company-owned bitcoin mining machines to customers, who pay rental fees based on bitcoins mined and bear electricity costs. Machines remain physically at company-controlled hosting facilities.

products.name: Bitcoin Miner Management and Technical Services
products.description: Provision of management and technical services for bitcoin mining operations, including potential future offerings such as crypto wallets, custody solutions, and trust services. These are service-based and may be delivered digitally or through operational support.

products.name: Orthopedic Bracing and Supports
products.description: Manufactured rigid and soft orthopedic bracing and related accessories used for injury prevention, support, and at-home physical therapy. Delivered through healthcare professionals and retail channels.

products.name: Therapeutic Devices for Pain Management and Rehabilitation
products.description: Manufactures and distributes hot and cold therapy devices, bone growth stimulators, vascular therapy systems, compression garments, and electrical stimulators for pain management and physical therapy. Delivered to healthcare providers and patients for non-surgical treatment and recovery.

products.name: Joint Replacement and Reconstructive Implants
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and distributes surgical implants and instrumentation for elective and non-elective joint replacement, limb reconstruction, and foot & ankle procedures. Delivered to orthopedic surgeons and healthcare systems globally.

products.name: Digital Surgical Planning and Enabling Technologies
products.description: Provides proprietary digital tools and technologies that support preoperative planning, intraoperative precision, and postoperative recovery for reconstructive surgery. Delivered as part of surgical solutions to healthcare providers.

products.name: Self-Storage Rental Services
products.description: Provision of month-to-month rental of storage space for personal or business use, delivered through a network of owned, partially owned, and managed physical self-storage properties across the United States. This service requires physical real estate assets, on-site management, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Third-Party Self-Storage Management Services
products.description: Management of self-storage properties owned by third parties, providing operational expertise, technology, and brand management in exchange for management fees. This service leverages the company's management systems and scale, requiring in-person and digital operational capabilities.

products.name: Tenant Reinsurance Services
products.description: Reinsurance of risks related to loss of goods stored by tenants, where customers purchase insurance from a non-affiliated insurer and the company fully reinsures such policies through a wholly-owned subsidiary. This service is regulated and involves financial risk management and insurance expertise.

products.name: Bridge Lending to Self-Storage Owners
products.description: Provision of mortgage and mezzanine loans to third-party self-storage owners, primarily for properties managed by the company. This service is financial in nature, generating interest and fee income, and may involve selling portions of loans to third parties.

products.name: Identity Intelligence Platform (CORE)
products.description: A cloud-native, AI-enabled platform that delivers real-time identity intelligence and analytics by integrating proprietary, public record, and publicly-available data. Delivered digitally via online interface, batch processing, API, and custom integrations to enterprise and organizational customers.

products.name: IDI Analytics and Information Solutions (idiCORE)
products.description: A suite of analytics and information solutions, including the idiCORE investigative product, providing actionable intelligence for identity verification, due diligence, fraud prevention, compliance, and debt recovery. Delivered digitally to organizations in financial services, insurance, healthcare, law enforcement, and other sectors.

products.name: FOREWARN Risk Mitigation Application
products.description: A mobile and web-based application tailored for the real estate industry, providing instant identity and risk information to professionals prior to face-to-face engagements. Delivered as a subscription-based digital service to individual users.

products.name: Craft Beer and Cider
products.description: Production, marketing, and sale of a wide portfolio of craft beers and ciders under multiple brands. Products are manufactured in company-owned breweries and distributed through a three-tier system to retail and on-premises locations across the U.S. and internationally.

products.name: Craft Spirits
products.description: Production, marketing, and sale of craft spirits, including bourbon whiskey, vodka, and gin, primarily under the Breckenridge Distillery brand. Spirits are manufactured in company-owned distilleries and distributed nationally and internationally.

products.name: Cannabis Products (Medical and Adult-Use)
products.description: Cultivation, production, distribution, and sale of medical and adult-use cannabis products, including whole flower, pre-rolls, vapes, topicals, edibles (gummies and chocolates), and beverages. Products are manufactured in state-of-the-art facilities in Canada, Portugal, and Germany, and distributed through direct-to-patient, wholesale, and retail channels in legal markets globally.

products.name: Hemp-Based Food Products
products.description: Development, manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of hemp-based food products such as hemp seeds, hemp oil, hemp protein, and snack foods under brands like Manitoba Harvest, Hemp Yeah!, Just Hemp Foods, and The Humble Seed. Products are produced in dedicated hemp processing facilities and sold through retail, wholesale, and direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: Hemp-Derived Delta-9 (HD-D9) Beverages
products.description: Production and sale of alternative adult beverages infused with hemp-derived Delta-9 THC, including seltzers and cocktails, under brands such as Happy Flower, 420 Fizz, Herb & Bloom, and Fizzy Jane's. Manufactured in beverage facilities and distributed in legally permissible U.S. states.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Distribution
products.description: Importation, packaging, and distribution of branded pharmaceuticals, including anti-rheumatic, oncology, and HIV prescription drugs, primarily through CC Pharma in Germany. Products are sourced from European suppliers and distributed to pharmacies and wholesalers.

products.name: Banking Hardware Solutions (ATMs, Cash Recyclers, Dispensers, Teller Automation, Advanced Kiosks)
products.description: Physically manufactured self-service banking devices, including ATMs, cash recyclers, dispensers, teller automation machines, and advanced kiosks, produced in global manufacturing facilities and delivered to financial institutions to automate and modernize branch operations.

products.name: Banking Software Solutions (DN Vynamic Banking Platform)
products.description: Cloud-native software platform and applications for financial institutions, enabling advanced transactions, analytics, integration with payment providers, and branch automation, delivered digitally and supported by professional services.

products.name: Banking Services (Installation, Maintenance, Managed Services, Advisory)
products.description: Comprehensive service offerings for banking customers, including installation, preventive and on-demand maintenance, managed services (such as ATM as-a-service, cash cycle management, security, and transaction oversight), and advisory services, delivered both remotely and onsite by skilled personnel.

products.name: Branch Automation Solutions
products.description: Integrated hardware and software solutions that automate and modernize the entire bank branch environment, including advanced self-service, cloud-native transaction processing, teller automation, and cash management technologies, requiring physical installation and digital integration.

products.name: Retail Hardware Solutions (EPOS, Self-Checkouts, Kiosks, Peripherals)
products.description: Manufactured electronic point-of-sale (EPOS) systems, self-checkout (SCO) platforms, kiosks, and related peripherals (printers, scales, mobile scanners) for retailers, designed to automate and digitize checkout and in-store transactions, delivered as physical products to retail clients.

products.name: Retail Software Solutions (DN Vynamic Retail Platform)
products.description: Open commerce software platform and modular applications for retailers, supporting in-store checkout, cross-channel transactions, loyalty, digital receipts, data analysis, compliance, and AI-powered loss prevention, delivered digitally and integrated with retail hardware.

products.name: Retail Services (Maintenance, Managed Services, Implementation, Advisory)
products.description: Comprehensive services for retail clients, including maintenance, availability and support for retail touchpoints, managed remote monitoring, implementation services for store openings and upgrades, multivendor incident resolution, and advisory services for store operations and technology adoption, delivered both remotely and onsite.

products.name: Allogeneic Gamma Delta T Cell Therapies for Autoimmune Diseases
products.description: Cell-based immunotherapies manufactured from unrelated donor gamma delta T cells, engineered with chimeric antigen receptors (CARs), and delivered as 'off-the-shelf' therapies to treat various autoimmune diseases. These therapies are produced using proprietary activation, engineering, and large-scale manufacturing processes, resulting in cryopreserved, ready-to-infuse cell products.

products.name: Allogeneic Gamma Delta T Cell Therapies for Cancer
products.description: Cell-based immunotherapies manufactured from unrelated donor gamma delta T cells, engineered with CARs and additional gene edits or armoring, designed to target and treat hematological malignancies and solid tumors. These therapies are produced using proprietary large-scale manufacturing and are intended for use as 'off-the-shelf' products.

products.name: Gene-Edited and Armored Allogeneic CAR Gamma Delta T Cell Therapies
products.description: Next-generation cell therapies that incorporate gene editing (e.g., CRISPR/Cas9) and armoring technologies (such as membrane-tethered IL-12) into allogeneic gamma delta T cells, enhancing their potency, specificity, and tolerability for cancer and autoimmune indications. These are manufactured using proprietary processes and delivered as cryopreserved, ready-to-use products.

products.name: Partnered Allogeneic CAR Gamma Delta T Cell Therapies (e.g., ADI-002)
products.description: Cell-based immunotherapies developed in collaboration with partners (such as Regeneron), based on proprietary gamma delta T cell engineering and manufacturing platforms, targeting specific cancer antigens. These are manufactured using the company's platform and supplied as 'off-the-shelf' products.

products.name: Private Passenger Auto Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage for private passenger vehicles, providing protection against liability for bodily injury and property damage from automobile accidents, as well as coverage for damage to the insured's own vehicle. Delivered through captive and independent agents, underwritten and administered by the company.

products.name: Non-Standard Auto Insurance
products.description: Auto insurance focused on minimum-limit liability coverage for higher-risk drivers, primarily delivered through independent agents. The company has recently exited several states for this product line.

products.name: Homeowners and Farmowners Insurance
products.description: Insurance policies covering damage to residential and farm buildings, equipment, and contents from perils such as fire, wind, hail, and theft, as well as liability coverage. Delivered through captive and independent agents, underwritten and administered by the company.

products.name: Crop Insurance
products.description: Crop hail and federally-backed multi-peril crop insurance policies protecting agricultural producers against yield losses from natural disasters and revenue declines. Policies are underwritten and administered in partnership with American Farm Bureau Insurance Services and issued through an approved insurance provider.

products.name: Commercial Multi-Peril and Excess Liability Insurance
products.description: Insurance products for businesses, including commercial multi-peril and excess liability coverages, protecting against a range of property and liability risks. Delivered through captive and independent agents, underwritten and administered by the company.

products.name: Assumed Reinsurance
products.description: Assumption of premiums and risks from other insurers through reinsurance pooling arrangements, including a run-off book of domestic and international reinsurance business. Managed as part of the company's overall risk and capital strategy.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Production
products.description: Exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas from owned and operated wells in the Appalachian Basin, primarily in the Utica Shale (Ohio) and Marcellus/Utica Shales (Pennsylvania). This involves physical extraction using drilling, hydraulic fracturing, and related field operations, requiring significant capital investment, regulated infrastructure, and in-person labor.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Production
products.description: Production and sale of natural gas liquids (NGLs) as a byproduct of oil and gas extraction, involving separation and processing at field facilities. NGLs are sold to external purchasers and require specialized infrastructure for gathering and processing.

products.name: Midstream Gathering and Water Infrastructure Services
products.description: Operation and ownership of gathering, compression, and transportation systems for natural gas, as well as freshwater and produced-water infrastructure. These assets support both internal production and may provide services to third parties, involving regulated pipelines and water handling systems.

products.name: Packaged Branded Food Products
products.description: Nathan’s Famous branded hot dogs, sausages, frozen crinkle-cut French fries, onion rings, pickles, bagel dogs, franks-in-a-blanket, mozzarella sticks, corn dog nuggets, hors d’oeuvres, and bottled mustard sold through supermarkets, mass merchandisers, club stores, and other retail food stores. These are manufactured by third-party licensees and distributed nationally, requiring food manufacturing and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Branded Product Program (Foodservice Sales)
products.description: Sales of Nathan’s Famous hot dogs and specialty products directly to foodservice operators and distributors for resale in venues such as restaurants, movie theaters, amusement parks, stadiums, convenience stores, and other foodservice outlets. Products are manufactured and distributed in bulk, requiring food production and distribution logistics.

products.name: Company-Owned Quick-Service Restaurants
products.description: Operation of Nathan’s Famous branded quick-service restaurants offering hot dogs, crinkle-cut French fries, beverages, and other menu items. These restaurants are company-operated, requiring in-person human labor, physical restaurant infrastructure, and regulated foodservice operations.

products.name: Franchised and Branded Menu Program Restaurants (including Virtual Kitchens)
products.description: Franchising of Nathan’s Famous restaurant concepts and branded menu programs to third-party operators, including traditional restaurants, virtual kitchens, and branded menu extensions in other foodservice venues. Franchisees operate under Nathan’s standards and pay royalties; virtual kitchens fulfill online delivery orders. Requires franchise management, training, and support systems.

products.name: Arthur Treacher’s Fish & Chips Branded Seafood Products
products.description: Branded seafood menu items, primarily fish and chips, offered as a menu-line extension within certain Nathan’s Famous restaurants and through online delivery platforms. Products are prepared in restaurant kitchens or virtual kitchens, leveraging existing foodservice infrastructure.

products.name: Complementary Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) Services
products.description: Terrestrial, resilient PNT services delivered via a ground-based transmitter network using low-band spectrum, designed to complement and back up GPS, including 3D location and timing data for critical infrastructure, public safety, and commercial applications. Delivered through proprietary networks and APIs/SDKs integrated into customer applications.

products.name: Altitude (Z-Axis) Location Services (Pinnacle)
products.description: Vertical location determination services using barometric sensors and a network of transmitters, primarily for public safety (E911), enterprise, and mass market applications. Delivered via API or SDK to devices and applications, covering major U.S. markets and select international locations.

products.name: 5G NR-Based PNT and Broadband Data Services (NextGen)
products.description: Integrated terrestrial PNT and 5G broadband data services leveraging optimized low-band spectrum, designed to provide both high-quality PNT and high-bandwidth two-way voice and data transmission, in partnership with mobile network operators. Subject to regulatory approval, enables simultaneous delivery of PNT and broadband services.

products.name: Technology Licensing and Related Services
products.description: Licensing of proprietary PNT and location technologies, including software and know-how, to device manufacturers, wireless carriers, and international partners, enabling commercialization of PNT solutions in various markets. Includes support and integration services for partners and customers.

products.name: Energy Efficiency Solutions
products.description: Design, engineering, and installation of projects to improve energy efficiency and control of building systems, including HVAC, lighting, building envelope, water management, and automation. Delivered through physical upgrades and technology integration, often under performance contracts.

products.name: Renewable Energy Plant Development and Operation
products.description: Development, construction, ownership, and operation of small-scale renewable energy plants using solar, wind, biomass, biogas, hydropower, and geothermal. Plants generate and sell electricity, heat, cooling, or renewable fuels to customers under long-term contracts. Involves physical infrastructure and regulated operations.

products.name: Battery Energy Storage Solutions (BESS)
products.description: Design, installation, and operation of battery energy storage systems to support energy reliability, grid services, and integration with renewable generation. Delivered as physical infrastructure, often integrated with other energy assets.

products.name: Microgrid and Integrated Infrastructure Solutions
products.description: Design and implementation of microgrids and integrated infrastructure, including mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems, advanced metering, and utility distribution. Delivered through engineering and construction of physical and digital systems for energy resilience and management.

products.name: Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Services
products.description: Ongoing operation, maintenance, and repair of facility energy systems and renewable energy plants, provided under multi-year contracts. Involves in-person technical labor and on-site staffing for both Ameresco-built and third-party projects.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) and Biogas Production and Sales
products.description: Production, processing, and sale of renewable natural gas and biogas from landfills, wastewater, and agricultural sources. RNG is processed and sold as fuel or injected into pipelines, involving physical plant operation and regulated fuel sales.

products.name: Solar PV Energy Products and Systems (Integrated-PV)
products.description: Sale and installation of photovoltaic solar energy products and systems, including integrated-PV solutions for on-site electricity generation. Delivered as physical products and turnkey installations.

products.name: Asset Management and Energy Analytics Software
products.description: Provision of digital software platforms for asset management, energy analytics, and building energy management, enabling customers to monitor, optimize, and identify savings opportunities. Delivered as digital-only or SaaS solutions.

products.name: Energy Supply Management Services
products.description: Management of energy supply contracts, procurement, and optimization for customers, including brokering and administration of power purchase agreements and energy supply agreements. Delivered as a service leveraging market expertise and digital tools.

products.name: Consulting and Enterprise Energy Management Services
products.description: Consulting services and enterprise-level energy management, including audits, planning, and strategic advisory for energy efficiency and sustainability. Delivered through expert human labor and digital tools.

products.name: Cardiovascular and Central Nervous System Therapeutics
products.description: Pharmaceutical products for the treatment of cardiovascular (CVS) and central nervous system (CNS) diseases, developed through internal R&D and external partnerships, and delivered as oral suspensions, nasal sprays, or injectable formulations. Products are manufactured by third-party contract organizations and distributed to wholesalers, pharmacies, and hospitals.

products.name: ArbliTM (Losartan Potassium Oral Suspension)
products.description: An FDA-approved oral liquid formulation of losartan potassium for hypertension, stroke risk reduction, and diabetic nephropathy, manufactured via third-party CMOs and distributed as a ready-to-use oral suspension for adults and children.

products.name: REZENOPYTM (Naloxone HCl Nasal Spray)
products.description: A high-dose (10mg) naloxone hydrochloride nasal spray for opioid overdose reversal, commercialized under an exclusive license, manufactured by a partner, and distributed in the U.S. as a needle-free, ready-to-use device.

products.name: SCN-104 (Multi-dose Dihydroergotamine Mesylate Injection Pen)
products.description: A multi-dose, pen-based self-injection system containing dihydroergotamine mesylate (DHE) for acute treatment of migraine and cluster headaches, developed for ease of use and consistent dosing, intended for subcutaneous administration and in clinical development.

products.name: SCN-106 (Biosimilar Thrombolytic Agent)
products.description: A biosimilar version of Cathflo Activase (tPA), a thrombolytic agent for management of thrombotically occluded catheters (CVADs), developed in partnership with a contract manufacturer, intended for sterile injectable administration and in preclinical/clinical development.

products.name: SCN-107 (Long-Acting Bupivacaine Injection)
products.description: A long-acting, microsphere-based injectable suspension of bupivacaine for postsurgical local and regional analgesia, designed for extended pain management over 5-7 days, developed under exclusive license and in clinical development.
